opportunities.name: Plan a city weekend trip and draft a summary email
opportunities.description: For a given city, travel dates and party size: look up the population on Wikipedia and the current weather on timeanddate, find a hotel on Booking.com, pick activities on Viator, find a dinner table by cuisine on OpenTable, save a summary note, then draft an email with the plan to a companion.
opportunities.site: wikipedia.org, timeanddate.com, booking.com, viator.com, opentable.com, local Notes and Mail apps
steps: On Wikipedia, search for {city}, open the article and read the population
On timeanddate.com, search for {city} and open its weather page; read the current temperature
On Booking.com, enter {city} as the destination, pick {checkin}–{checkout}, set adults to {party_size}, search, and note the top hotel and its price
On Viator, search '{activity_1} {city}' and open the top result; repeat for '{activity_2} {city}'
On OpenTable, set the date to {checkin} at 20:00 for {party_size} people, search '{city} {cuisine}', and note the top restaurant and the 19:30 slot
In Notes, add the entry '{city} {checkin}-{checkout}: pop X, temp, hotel €price, activities, dinner {restaurant} 19:30'

In Mail, create a new message to {recipient}, set the subject to '{city} weekend {checkin}-{checkout}', and write the body 'Hi {name}, plan: hotel …, activities …, dinner at … ({cuisine}) on {checkin}.'
